Bill.BriefDescription: Addressing the conversion of existing facilities to house offenders violating community supervision.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the conversion of existing facilities to houseoffenders violating community supervision; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of corrections shallconduct an analysis of the necessary capacity throughout the state toappropriately confine offenders who violate community supervision. Theanalysis must include, but is not limited to: (a) Recommended development or conversion of facilities to decreasereliance on the availability of local correctional facilities to houseviolators including estimated costs; and (b) A predesign analysis for a facility to provide inpatienttreatment, therapies, and counseling. In conducting the predesignanalysis, the department shall assume the facility will be colocatedwith an existing department of corrections center in western Washingtonand house approximately two hundred violators. (2) The department shall report the results of its analysis to thegovernor and the appropriate committees of the legislature by November15, 2008. p. 1 SB 6244 (3) To the extent possible within existing funds, the department isauthorized to proceed with the conversion of existing facilities thatare appropriate to house violators.
